kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنهزم (form VII)
# أَنْهَزِمُ (ʔanhazimu) /ʔan.ha.zi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَزَمَ (inhazama)
# أَنْهَزِمَ (ʔanhazima) /ʔan.ha.zi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَزَمَ (inhazama)
# أَنْهَزِمْ (ʔanhazim) /ʔan.ha.zim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَزَمَ (inhazama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
